newsitem.title: UK: Qatar's Rasgas raises $1.2 billion via two bonds.
newsitem.headline: Qatar's Rasgas raises $1.2 billion via two bonds.

text.p: Ras Laffan Liquefied Natural Gas Co (Rasgas) has launched two bonds worth a total $1.2 billion, joint lead managers Goldman Sachs (books) and CS First Boston said on Thursday.
There are $800 million of September 15, 2014 bonds with an average life of 15 years. They carry an 8.294 percent coupon and were priced at par to yield 187.5 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
There are $400 million of September 15, 2006 bonds with an average life of 7.3 years. They carry an 7.628 percent coupon and were priced at par to yield 135 b.p. over U.S. Treasuries.
Fees for the two deals are 1.2 points. Bonds are available in denominations of $1,000. Governing law is New York.
